author: packs
description: H6-T2: entitled seats against installs per software product and version, and the products installed on more devices than their licences cover.
name: asset-management-licence-compliance

definition.name: IT Assets: Licence Position
definition.sql: WITH entitled AS ( SELECT software_ref, COALESCE(SUM(seats), 0)::bigint AS seats FROM software_licence WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= NOW()) AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= NOW()) GROUP BY software_ref), installed AS ( SELECT software_ref, COUNT(*)::bigint AS installs FROM software_install WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE GROUP BY software_ref) SELECT p.id AS software_ref, p.name, p.version, COALESCE(e.seats, 0) AS entitled_seats, COALESCE(i.installs, 0) AS installs, COALESCE(i.installs, 0) - COALESCE(e.seats, 0) AS shortfall FROM software_product p LEFT JOIN entitled e ON e.software_ref = p.id LEFT JOIN installed i ON i.software_ref = p.id WHERE p.is_active IS NOT FALSE ORDER BY shortfall DESC, p.name

definition.name: IT Assets: Over-Deployed Software
definition.sql: SELECT t.software_ref, t.name, t.version, t.entitled_seats, t.installs, t.shortfall FROM (WITH entitled AS ( SELECT software_ref, COALESCE(SUM(seats), 0)::bigint AS seats FROM software_licence WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= NOW()) AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= NOW()) GROUP BY software_ref), installed AS ( SELECT software_ref, COUNT(*)::bigint AS installs FROM software_install WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE GROUP BY software_ref) SELECT p.id AS software_ref, p.name, p.version, COALESCE(e.seats, 0) AS entitled_seats, COALESCE(i.installs, 0) AS installs, COALESCE(i.installs, 0) - COALESCE(e.seats, 0) AS shortfall FROM software_product p LEFT JOIN entitled e ON e.software_ref = p.id LEFT JOIN installed i ON i.software_ref = p.id WHERE p.is_active IS NOT FALSE) t WHERE t.shortfall > 0 ORDER BY t.shortfall DESC

title: Pack: software licence compliance
